eligibility_rules: Only women will be eligible. Women should be permanent Residents of Tamil Nadu. There is a travel limit of 30-kilometers.

how_to_apply: Mode: Offline No formal application is needed. Women simply board the bus and request a zero-value ticket from the conductor.
